messages:
rachel: Small copy review for the modal when a Dedicated pool is resumed after being paused. Current title: "Resume pool?" Body: "Are you sure you want to resume?" Button: Resume / Cancel. Feels bland and doesn't mention billing or timing. Figma: https://figma.redwood/dedicated/resume-modal noah: We should make the consequence clear: resuming will re-enable capacity and billing resumes immediately. Proposed title: "Resume dedicated capacity" Body option A: "Resuming will re-enable GPU capacity and billing will resume immediately. Estimated time to serve: ~2 minutes." Button primary: "Resume capacity" secondary: "Cancel". zara: Tone + accessibility notes: make the body explicit about cost and expected readiness time. Add aria-describedby on the primary button that references the sentence about billing/time. Also default focus should be on Cancel to reduce accidents. Avoid vague words like "resume" alone on the CTA; be explicit as Noah suggests. rachel: I also want a softer variant for trial users: "Resuming will start billing at your plan rate. You'll be charged from the moment the pool becomes active." but keep main modal concise. For mobile use a single-line helper and shorter CTA: "Resume" -> maybe "Resume pool". noah: Implementation suggestion for SRs and keyboard users: ```

Resume dedicated capacity

Resuming will re-enable GPU capacity. Billing resumes immediately; the pool should be ready in ~2 minutes.

``` Make sure the aria-describedby points to resume-body so screen readers catch the billing note. zara: Also add an inline secondary helper link: "See pricing details" that opens billing modal. Make sure link has discernible text and high contrast. For localization, avoid punctuation-heavy sentences and keep the billing phrase near the start for clarity. dev-bot: Added checklist to ticket #4623: 1) Update modal copy to "Resume dedicated capacity" + body per approved wording, 2) primary CTA labeled "Resume capacity" with aria-describedby, 3) default focus on Cancel, 4) include "See pricing details" link, 5) mobile CTA shortened to "Resume pool", 6) unit test for focus and SR announcement. (auto-note) rachel: Final approved copy (desktop): Title: "Resume dedicated capacity" Body: "Resuming will re-enable GPU capacity. Billing resumes immediately. Expected time to serve: ~2 minutes." CTA primary: "Resume capacity" CTA secondary: "Cancel" Helper link: "See pricing details". Mobile CTA: "Resume pool". Anyone object? noah: Approved. I'll implement and make sure reduced-motion respects transitions. Also add a short analytics event when users resume so Product can track accidental resumes. zara: I'll do an a11y quick pass post-PR. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
